BC_description: Async collection and control flow methods now return a Promise when the final callback parameter is omitted, making them awaitable. This affects methods like each, map, filter, reduce, series, parallel, waterfall, and others.
Adaptation_method: When using Async methods without a callback, they now return a Promise that can be awaited. Update your code to either: 1) Continue using callbacks: `async.map(items, iterator, (err, results) => { /* handle results */ })`, or 2) Use await with the returned Promise: `const results = await async.map(items, iterator)`. If you previously relied on Async methods to run asynchronously without providing a callback or handling a return value, you may need to update your code to handle or ignore the returned Promise.
